name: Open-reversal ridge score, BTC+ETH+SOL pooled
description: BTC, ETH and SOL: after a window opens, one ridge score (pooled over the three coins, refit monthly on earlier windows) combines the previous window's move size, its late confirmation, Binance volume vs the slot's 14-day median and the clock; buy the reversal side when predicted net PnL beats 6c.
hypothesis: sol-revmodel's score on SOL alone failed its lockbox (-6.7c, 99 mkts). Pooling the three coins with flow data triples the fit sample and trades, and the forced-flow overshoot into the boundary is common to them. Dev screen (walk-forward Apr-Aug, pooled fit, next real fills): thr 4c +3.4c (n=1101, se 1.4, BTC +2.3/ETH +4.9/SOL +3.4, 5/5 months positive); thr 7c +8.5c (n=199). thr 6c fixed in advance from that dose-response. Wrong if the engine walk-forward CI <= 0 or the lockbox loses; family lockbox history (sol-revmodel fail, midrev/volrev/overreact weak passes) makes any pass weak evidence.
next: Rejected: full 1/3 inconclusive -0.63c (CI -5.97..+4.79, 296 mkts); research screen (+3.4c at thr 4c, +8.5c at 7c) did not carry to the engine. No lockbox run. Don't retry.
